newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds end mixed, seen volatile.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds end mixed, seen volatile.

text.p: Austrian bonds ended mixed on Thursday after a changeable session amid meagre volumes, mainly characterised by developments in the German market.
The short end came under pressure from deutschmark weakness and the long end gained, traders said, noting a lack of investors in the market.
"We are seeing at the moment a very fast and very efficient flattening out of the curve," said one.
Dealers were sceptical of significant advances in the near future.
"I assume we're not reaching for the skies," said one.
* 10-year benchmark 5.625 pct bond maturing July 2007 stable at 100.55 to yield 5.55 pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.31/41 to yield 5.58/57 pct.
* Five-year 4.625 bond maturing May 2002 down five bps at 100.10 to yield 4.59 (4.58) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.76/86 to yield 4.68/65 percent.
* Austrian bond future down 20 bps at 110.35 on turnover of 292 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany five bps, five-year spread 18 bps.
* Money market rates steady with three-month VIBOR at 3.397 and overnight money at 3.11/3.36. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
